text:
nora: FYI opened a tiny docs PR to refresh the hello-lumen quickstart with PKCE + tiny Python snippet and a note about the decklink local token helper. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4812. Need: JS+Py snippet sanity, checksum for decklink, and a Windows smoke test.

devin: I'll review the JS snippet. Add env var names (REDWOOD_CLIENT_ID, AUTH_DOMAIN) and a curl code-exchange example.

rahim: Please include SDK compatibility (>=0.9.0) and a one-line migration note from cookie-helper to decklink. Also call out Dedicated/private auth_host override.

ci-bot: CI: docs-build passed for PR #4812  preview: https://deploy-preview-4812--redwood-docs.netlify.app/hello-lumen.html

qa-olga: Running Windows smoke now (Win10). Steps?

nora: Steps: npm ci; npm run dev; .\decklink.exe auth --client-id %REDWOOD_CLIENT_ID% --redirect http://localhost:3000/callback; then curl -X POST https://auth.example.com/token -d "grant_type=authorization_code&code=...&redirect_uri=http://localhost:3000/callback". Open http://localhost:3000 and confirm greeting.

qa-olga: Smoke OK on Win10. Decklink binary runs, token exchange succeeds, UI shows "Hello, Lumen". Left one tiny wording nit about localhost redirect advice.

nora: Thanks all 680 will apply the nit and merge after spellcheck. I'll post a note to #all-hands once live.
